name: nbfm
label: Narrowband FM (voice)
description: Narrowband FM receiver for VHF voice — NOAA weather, marine, aircraft (FM mode), 2 m / 70 cm amateur, public safety. Source 2.4 MS/s IQ. Channelizer decimates by 50 to a 48 kS/s baseband (~12 kHz one-sided post-LPF, comfortably passes ±5 kHz deviation + audio sidebands and rejects aliases). FmDemod runs at 48 kS/s with `max_deviation_hz: 5000` — same block as WBFM, narrower scaling. Output goes straight to the AudioSink at the AudioContext rate; no post-demod decimator needed because the channelizer already lands us on 48 kS/s. Server-side FFT/LogMagU8 spectrum chain matches WBFM so the visualisation is identical.
